CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   B. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Sinai Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Sinai Covenant.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Sinai Covenant has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.
   B. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.
   D. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.
   C. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   C. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

10. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .
   C. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   B. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Trinity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Sacraments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Ethics and Morality 4.2 Human Rights 4.3 Human Sexuality 4.4 Marriage  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Ethics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Holy Trinity; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Christian Ethics; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
